findings.evidence: return [value for value in left if value in right]
findings.summary: Checking membership with 'value in right' for a list results in O(N * M) overall time complexity.
findings.suggested_action: Convert 'right' to a set (e.g. 'right_set = set(right)') before filtering to achieve O(N + M) average time complexity while preserving left order and duplicates.

limitations: No runtime profiling measurements or benchmark harness were provided in the snapshot.
